submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L3 because it is the most capable candidate that satisfies the Level-1 latency constraint: Algorithm-L2 is excluded by its measured 5.8 us latency, while Algorithm-L3 has measured 3.1 us latency and is more advanced than the fixed-window Algorithm-L1. I set the threshold to 40 GeV, within the allowed 20–60 GeV range, as the nominal working point for the 8 kHz allocation. The available project documents do not include the requested rate/efficiency simulation curves, so the rate and >=80% signal-efficiency compliance cannot be independently verified from the provided evidence.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L1, Algorithm-L2, and Algorithm-L3; the recommendation is Algorithm-L3.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: rate_allocation.md states the allocation is 8 kHz, but no rate-versus-threshold or signal-efficiency simulation results are present in the available project documents/tools. Algorithm-L3 is chosen as the best latency-compliant clustering/calibration candidate; Algorithm-L2 is latency-ineligible.

requirements.requirement: The signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.
requirements.evidence: No signal-efficiency results at 8 kHz are included in the available documents/tools, so the >=80% hard requirement cannot be verified from the provided evidence.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: firmware_testbench_results.md reports Algorithm-L3 latency = 3.1 us, below the 4.0 us budget. Algorithm-L2 is 5.8 us and therefore excluded; Algorithm-L1 is 1.9 us.
The recommended threshold is 40 GeV, which lies within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L3 at 40 GeV.
